item.title: [New] The Copilot desktop app's built-in browser on Windows and Mac gets enterprise policies for security, privacy, authentication, network and download control
item.description:
An in-app browser is a second browser on the endpoint; once BrowsingEnabled is turned on it must carry the same site, download and authentication restrictions as the corporate browser or it becomes a gap in web and data-loss controls.

Copilot · Keep BrowsingEnabled off unless there is a business need; if you enable it, mirror your Edge security, download and site-access policies in the new Copilot in-app browsing policies and test sign-in flows with a pilot group. Confirm in your own tenant.

item.title: [New] Copilot in Teams channels answers questions over every post and reply in a channel, in public preview from December 2026
item.description:
A summary over a whole channel surfaces old posts a member never scrolled to, including credentials or incident details pasted months ago; the exposure is what the member could already read, made easy to find.

Teams · Before the preview reaches users, review which large or shared channels hold sensitive history, and baseline CopilotInteraction records whose context is a Teams channel.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra roll out across Microsoft Copilot; Astra is available only where the tenant enables the OpenAI subprocessor
item.description:
Which model processes a prompt is a data-processing question: a tenant that enabled the OpenAI subprocessor for one feature now routes Copilot prompts in Office apps to it as well, and the audit record (ModelTransparencyDetails) is the only place that shows it.

Copilot · Confirm whether the OpenAI subprocessor is enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center and that the decision is recorded; watch CopilotInteraction audit records for the model provider.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Microsoft 365 Copilot app turns on a new search experience by default for users without a Copilot licence, from late November 2026
item.description:
Better search surfaces whatever users can already open, including overshared files and connected third-party sources: oversharing becomes easier to find, not new.

Copilot · Tell the help desk about the toggle back to classic search, and review oversharing reports for sites and connectors users will now find more easily.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot desktop app can sync passwords, personal info, settings and browsing history with Microsoft Edge, opt-in by the user, from mid-December 2026
item.description:
Saved passwords leave the browser you govern and land in a second app: a token or session theft on the Copilot app now reaches the same credential store, and Edge sync policies you set may not cover the new path until Microsoft publishes its control.

Copilot · Before mid-December, check whether your Edge sync policies (SyncDisabled, SyncTypesListDisabled, password manager settings) apply to the Copilot desktop app once Microsoft documents it, and decide whether password sync is allowed.
